steps.en: Ships initial instructions that make the agent check for a relevant skill before any task
steps.zh: 附带初始指令：让 agent 干活前先查有没有该用的 skill

steps.en: Ask for what you want, as usual
Probes what you really want and shows the design in short chunks
steps.zh: 追问真实需求，把设计分段给你看

steps.en: Opens an isolated worktree and splits work into 2–5 minute tasks
steps.zh: 开隔离 worktree，拆成 2–5 分钟的小任务

steps.en: Dispatches a subagent per task with TDD, reviewing after each
steps.zh: 每个任务派子 agent 按 TDD 实现，做完就 review

steps.en: Runs the tests and asks: merge, open a PR, or discard
steps.zh: 跑测试，问你合并、提 PR 还是丢弃

value.en: The agent follows a disciplined process and works autonomously for hours without drifting
value.zh: agent 按有纪律的流程自主干几个小时而不跑偏
